title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Sour Pineapple Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Sour Pineapple delivers a tropical burst of juicy, tangy pineapple with a bold sour twist for a refreshing and vibrant all-day vape. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, providing extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. These pods feature advanced dual mesh coil technology to ensure consistently smooth vapour and vibrant, intense flavour. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design simplify refilling, allowing for a hassle-free vaping experience. Together, the pod and refill container provide up to 6000 puffs, offering incredible value and convenience. Filled with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, these pods provide a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine satisfaction, ideal for both experienced and newer adult vapers. Simply replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the bold Sour Pineapple flavour.
